ModMetaData.name: ReShade for RimWorld (unofficial) - Diagnostic
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
Only use this if ReShade for RimWorld isn't working for you and I asked you to.
It's the same mod but it writes a log of everything it does, from the start of the game, so I can find out why it didn't work on your PC. It's not meant for playing and won't get updates with the normal mod.
How to use it: Turn off ReShade for RimWorld and turn this one on instead, then start the game and do what you did before (press F2, or click "Open the overlay" in the mod options). Go to Options, Mod options, ReShade for RimWorld and click "Save the log and open its folder". The log is only kept while the game is open, it isn't saved anywhere until you click it. Send me the "Send this" file from that folder, then go back to the normal mod.
The log has your GPU, OS, mod list, folder paths and ReShade settings in it, nothing else.
Normal mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826441547
AI was used to help code/fix issues
